portal_description:
The rhel-system-roles-sap package contains collection of Ansible roles
which configures a RHEL system according to applicable SAP notes so that
any SAP software can be installed.

* SAPInstance: Integrating the upstream patch for systemd based SAP Start-Up Framework. (BZ#2024186)
